name: Istoriya o Shiriru
source:
Shiriru is an ordinary swordsman from a godforsaken village. One night, he meets a creature that calls itself his "brother" and his "dark side." It steals his soul, leaves him to die in the forest, and vanishes into the darkness.

From that moment on, Shiriru's life becomes an endless race: to reclaim his soul, to deal with an army of the undead, to stop the awakening of dragons — and to understand why his Light and Dark sides have become separate people. But the main battle is yet to come — the battle with who he might become. 

[From [url=https://rofoks.itch.io/shiriru-thestory]itch.io[/url]]
